title: Finite transport of the ordinary constant-completion comparison
statement: Let F be the supplied algebraic inverse-image data for an adjunction of finite-limit-preserving sheaf inverse images. For a commutative Noetherian ring A, ideal I and n, there exist a functor X from completed J-modules to finite J'-modules and natural isomorphisms from each finite-reduced side of ordinaryPullComparison F A I to X such that the reduced ordinary comparison followed by the target transport equals the source transport.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 03EL, 093M; the ordinary coefficient argument underlying sites-cohomology.tex Tag 06YY

proof.text: Apply the normalized compatible-pair theorem to obtain both transports and their equation for the canonical finite quotient model. Use this model as X. No arbitrary unnormalized isomorphisms are chosen.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryReducedPull_transport
    (V : Sheaf J' (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) (adj : L ⊣ V)
    [PreservesFiniteLimits L] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (X : Mod (completed J A I) ⥤ Mod (finite J' A I n))
      (s : (res (coefficientMap J A I) ⋙ pull F (constantMap F A) ⋙
        change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅ X)
      (t : (pull F (completedMap F A I) ⋙ res (coefficientMap J' A I) ⋙
        change (quotient J' A I n)) ≅ X),
      Functor.whiskerRight (ordinaryPullComparison F A I)
          (change (quotient J' A I n)) ≫ t.hom = s.hom
